cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 160 from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are cruising at 11000 meters, over WX, make the initial contact with Zhengzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航160，从东京飞往广州，你现在在11000米巡航，飞过WX，与郑州区调建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, from Tokyo to Guangzhou, we are cruising at 11,000 meters over WX.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，澳航160，从东京飞往广州，我们在11000米巡航，飞过WX。

cards.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect higher levels, ask Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你想知道什么时候可以上高度，询问郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, confirm when we can climb to higher levels?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，澳航160，证实什么时候我们可以上高度？

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing LKO, but for now continue descend to and maintain 9200 meters. Reduce to the minimum speed due the temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，郑州区调，预计过LKO后可以上高度，但现在，继续下降并保持9200米，由于临时航路管控，减小至最小速度。
cards.referenceText: Expect further climb after passing LKO, continue descend to and maintain 9200 meters. Reduce to the minimum speed due the temporary airway restriction, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计过LKO后可以上高度，继续下降并保持9200米，由于临时航路管控，减小至最小速度，QFA160。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Orbit right at present position until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，当前位置盘旋，直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right at present position until further advised, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller if you are going to orbit any longer, you will reach the minimum fuel.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员，如果你继续盘旋，你将达到最低燃油。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, we will reach the minimum fuel if we are going to orbit any longer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，QFA160，如果我们继续盘旋，我们将达到最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Zhengzhou control, roger, after this orbit track direct to AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，郑州区调，收到，这次盘旋过后直飞AKOMA。
cards.referenceText: Roger, track direct to AKOMA after this orbit, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，这次盘旋过后直飞AKOMA，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find you won't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou. You decide to divert to Changsha airport. Notify Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你发现你没有足够的燃油飞往广州，你决定改航到长沙机场，告知郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, request divert to Changsha airport due fuel shortage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，QFA160，由于燃油短缺，请求改航长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, standby for your request, the temporary restriction is canceled. Resume your normal speed, proceed direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，稍等，当前限制取消，恢复到正常速度，直飞OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Resume my normal speed, proceed direct to OBLIK, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复到正常速度，直飞OBLIK, QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Your navigation system has a problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control and ask for radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的导航系统出问题了，仪表无法指示飞机正确的位置信息，告知郑州区调，请求雷达监控。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, our navigation system has a problem, the instrument is showing inaccurate position of our aircraft, request radar monitoring.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，QFA160，我们的导航系统出问题了，仪表无法指示飞机正确的位置信息，请求雷达监视。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160 roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 8 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7 and request diversion from Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，收到，你现在稍微左偏，右转8度，联系武汉区调134.7，向武汉区调请求改航。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right 8 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, wilco, good day, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转8度，联系武汉区调134.7，照办，再见，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, your transponder code is 4525, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你保持在9200米，飞过OBLIK，你的应答机编码是4525，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, we are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK with transponder code 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，QFA160，我们在9200米保持，飞过OBLIK，应答机编码4525。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA160, Wuhan control, radar contact. I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha Airport.
B: Tell Wuhan control you are doing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to standby.
cards.audioTextZh:
QFA160武汉区调，雷达识别，我了解到你遭遇导航问题，燃油短缺，证实你要改航长沙机场。
告知武汉区调你在执行检查单，稍等。
cards.referenceText: We are doing the checklist, standby, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在执行检查单，稍等，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you will change the alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知武汉区调，你现在依靠基本导航仪表飞行，你将改航到武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments and we will change the alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，QFA160，我们现在依靠基本导航仪表飞行，并将改航到武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, roger, divert to Wuhan Airport approved, descend to and maintain 4800 meters, contact 120.45 when reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，收到，同意改航到武汉机场，下到4800米保持，到4800米后联系120.45。
cards.referenceText: Roger, divert to Wuhan Airport approved, descend to and maintain 4800 meters, contact 120.45 when reaching, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，同意改航到武汉机场，下到4800米保持，到4800米后联系120.45，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: You are reaching 4800 meters, receiving information B, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你到达4800米，收到通播B，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA160, 4800 meters, information B.

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, B is current, expect ZF-01A arrival runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播B，预计ZF-01A进场，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Information B, expect ZF-01A arrival runway 36R, QFA160.

cards.audioText:
C: QFA160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel, you do not need to declare fuel emergency.
cards.audioTextZh:
QFA160，你宣布燃油紧急情况吗？
告知管制员你还有2个多小时的燃油，你不需要宣布燃油紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不需要，我们还有2个多小时的燃油，澳航160。
